dataset_title: Within-study standing-biomass summaries by mowing treatment and sampling month
derivation: For each month × mowing-treatment group, calculate n, arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, minimum and maximum from non-missing Biomass values. Convert g DM/m² to t DM/ha by multiplying by 0.01. Do not sum June and August values.
license: CC BY 4.0 applies to source Zenodo version record; this is a GreenHub-derived descriptive extract
applicability: Within-study descriptive summaries for Dutch roadside plots only; not annual harvestable yield or delivered feed.
limitations: Summary rows are reproducible descriptive statistics, not published model contrasts or independent samples beyond the source plot records.
An August group has n=9 because one source value is missing; November biomass was not measured.
Standing biomass after a June cut is not the harvested June mass or a validated annual regrowth yield.
Site, soil, ecological management, collection access, and GreenHub contract representativeness are unresolved.
